title: TopiaForge Gamemode Contract Conformance Fixture
description: One cross-language conformance case. There is deliberately no 'skip', 'only' or 'runners' field: which runners must execute a case is declared once per channel in index.json, so a case can never quietly exempt itself from one language.

id.description: Unique within the whole fixture tree, and equal to the file stem.

kind.description: Selects the runner's dispatch arm. Both runners dispatch exhaustively with a failing default, so adding a kind here without teaching both runners fails the harness rather than silently skipping.

selection.description: The launcher-side WorldSelection JSON. Required by 'launch-intent-round-trip'; forbidden elsewhere.

intent.description: The one-shot worldLaunch intent carried on the launch profile.

expect.description: Keyed by runner. index.json's channelRunners decides which keys are required; a missing or extra runner key fails the harness.

divergenceReason.description: Mandatory whenever two runners expect different outcomes for the same operation. Both runners enforce it, so an unexplained divergence cannot land.

errorCodes.description: Compared as a set, not a prefix or a count. The existing tests/fixtures/manifests corpus compares only the accept/reject verdict; that is what let the two hand-written readers drift.

normalized.description: Deep-equality check on the value the runner produces. What 'produces' means is fixed per kind by both runners.
